headline.title: First flakes for Adirondacks.
headline.text: Up to {{s:2}} on the summit of Whiteface early Friday to Saturday morning. 27 of 31 resorts get cold enough nights for snow guns this week, mostly in White Mountains and Western Maine. Killington typically opens first, around Nov 8.

insights.text: First flakes: about {{s:0.5}} at the summit Friday morning to early Saturday (models {{r:0.4,4.2}}). It starts as rain ({{l:0.56}}), even at the summit, then changes to snow early Saturday as colder air arrives. It won't last: highs reach {{t:49}} Monday.
Snow guns can run early Saturday to Sunday morning: about 32 hours cold enough at the summit, getting down to {{t:18}} once humidity is factored in. The base is cold enough for 15 of those hours.
Typically opens around Nov 27, 44 days out. Openings depend on snowmaking nights, not the calendar.
